payout_quote: Giggster collects 19% of the total booking value. There is no cost for listing your location on Giggster.
steps: Create a Giggster host account and list your property (residential, commercial, studio, or vehicle) with photos, rates, and house rules - you must own the property or have written approval.
Respond to renter inquiries; approve or deny booking requests within 48 hours, or send a custom negotiated rate.
Do a pre-shoot walkthrough with the production and sign the standard Location Agreement generated by Giggster.
Your payout (total price minus the 19% Giggster commission) is deposited into your bank account within 7 days of the start of the shoot.
catches: Giggster takes a 19% commission out of the host's total payout on every booking; a separate processing fee is charged to the renter.
Earnings are fully variable: you set the rate (Giggster suggests ~$150-$250/hr for private homes) but bookings depend on production demand in your market; most listings get few or no shoots.

Unlike Peerspace, Giggster provides NO host insurance: 'Production insurance ... is provided by the production team.' Giggster's Damage Protection is optional, purchased by the renter, and is explicitly 'not an insurance policy'.
You must be the property owner or have written approval to rent the location - renters/roommates cannot list without it.
Productions bring crews of 15-30+ people, equipment, trucks, and overtime risk; always do timestamped before/after walkthroughs and consider requiring a security deposit.
Check city film-permit requirements and HOA/lease rules - some cities require permits even for small shoots.
Shoots are infrequent and seasonal by market; income is lumpy, not monthly.
biggest_catch: Giggster keeps 19% of every booking, provides no host insurance of its own (damage protection is optional, renter-paid, and explicitly 'not an insurance policy'), and bookings are entirely demand-driven - most listings get few or no productions, so there is no guaranteed income.
eligibility: Must own the property or have written approval from the owner to rent the location. Available in Giggster's served markets (primarily US major metros); productions vary by market demand. 18+.
timing: Listing is free and self-serve; payout deposited within 7 days of the start of the shoot. First booking depends on market demand and can take months.
